columns: Aim: launcher raised and levelled at the target, braced, feet apart
Fire: recoil, the launcher kicks up, shoulders pushed back, hair lifting
Reload / recover: launcher lowered, one hand on the loading slide
Charge: deeper crouch, launcher pulled tight to the shoulder, cape flaring
Charged release: heavy recoil, back foot slides back (feet stay on the baseline)
Avalanche Strike windup: launcher swung down to the hip, leaning into it
Volley 1: firing toward the left side of the fan
Volley 3: firing toward the right side of the fan
Hold: launcher still raised, smoke shape at the muzzle **not** drawn, hair settling
